column1: # Trade words for search and matching (W-06): one line per canonical word — kind <TAB> canonical <TAB> variants separated by |
# The database (0071 seed, generated) and the browser (web/src/trade_terms.js) are both written from this file by
#   python3 tools/trade/gen_terms.py        (--check: exit 1 when either generated copy is out of date)
# Variants are written as people write them; both sides normalise them the same way (trade_norm / dxTrade.norm):
# lower case, أإآٱ→ا ة→ه ى→ي ؤ→و ئ→ي, no harakat or tatweel, Arabic-Indic digits → 0-9.
# Kinds: form (dosage form) · unit (pack / quantity unit) · strength (a unit joined to the number before it: 500 mg → 500mg)
#        market (trade words: never part of an item's key) · drug (a medicine name in Arabic and English) · cat (agency categories)
# Not here on purpose (owner's item W-06): Franco-Arabic spellings, and «باتش» (a patch far more often than a batch in this trade).
# Drugbox moderators add words in the database with trade_term_add(); add them here too so the demo and new builds know them.
